source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kidney failure and dialysis (PDF 20-22).

blocks.text: Kidney (renal) failure aisi halat hai jis mein gurde khoon se fuzlaat chhanne aur jism ke pani aur namak ka tawazun qaboo karne ki salahiyat kho dete hain.

blocks.caption: Chronic aur acute kidney failure
rows: aksar ilaj se theek ho jati hai
ziabetes, high blood pressure, gurde ki bimari jaise purani infection ya glomeruli ki sozish
gurde ki infection; pathri, bladder cancer ya bare prostate se peshab ki nali ka band hona; kuch dawayein jaise NSAIDs; renal arteries ya arterioles mein khoon ke lothre

blocks.text: Renal dialysis kidney failure ka ilaj hai jis mein metabolic fuzlaat masnooi tareeqe se khoon se chhane jate hain. Is ki do aam qismein hain, haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis.

items: Haemodialysis: khoon jism ke bahar dialyzer se guzara jata hai, jo cellulose ki semipermeable membrane wala filter hai. Aik catheter artery mein, aam taur par baazu mein, dala jata hai; khoon dialyzer se guzarta hai jis mein khaas mayi, dialysate, bhi hota hai. Fuzlaat, pani aur namak khoon se membrane paar kar ke dialysate mein ghul jate hain, aur saaf khoon doosre catheter se vein ke raaste jism mein wapas aata hai.

Peritoneal dialysis mein peritoneal membrane istemal hoti hai jo pait ki cavity ki andaruni teh hai. 1.5 se 2 L dialysate catheter se pait mein dala aur 4 se 6 ghante chhora jata hai; fuzlaat aur zaid mayi peritoneum ki capillaries se us mein aa jate hain. Phir dialysate nikal kar phenk diya jata hai, aur yeh amal din mein kai baar dohraya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Khoon baazu ki artery se laal nali mein nikal kar dialyzer se neeche guzarta aur vein mein wapas jata hai. Dialyzer ke andar khoon dialysis membrane ki laal nalyon mein neeche behta hai aur dialysate un ke darmiyan oopar. Taaza (fresh) dialysate neeche wali thaili se aata hai aur istemal shuda (used) dialysate doosri thaili mein jata hai.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Blood removed from artery, Purified blood returned to vein, Dialyzer, Dialysis membrane, Direction of dialysate flow (neele teer), Direction of blood flow (kaale teer), Fresh dialysate, Used dialysate. Mure hue teer khoon ka chakkar dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Dhar ka pehlu se manzar, peeche reerh ki haddi. Peritoneal cavity ko peritoneal membrane (peeli) gherti hai jis mein khoon ki nalyan (laal) hain, aur cavity dialysate se bhari hai. Catheter pait ki deewar se bahar Y jor tak jata hai: oopar taaza dialysate ki thaili, neeche istemal shuda dialysate ki. Chhote teer fuzlaat (wastes) ka khoon se dialysate mein jana dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peeli lakeer peritoneal membrane hai aur us ke andar laal lakeer khoon ki nalyan. Dialysate catheter se cavity mein bhara jata hai; membrane ki nalyon se fuzlaat aur zaid pani chhote teeron ki simt mein dialysate mein aate hain. Kuch ghanton baad yeh dialysate neeche wali thaili mein nikal diya jata hai.

items: Khoon tak rasai infection ka khatra barhati hai.
Hypotension (kam blood pressure) haemodialysis ki aam pecheedgi hai.
Namak ki miqdar badalne se muscles mein khinchao (cramps) ho sakte hain.
Dialysis se anaemia (khoon ki kami) ho sakti hai, jis se thakan aur kamzori hoti hai.
Bohat zyada mayi bohat jaldi nikalne se pani ki kami ya kam blood pressure ho sakta hai.
Ilaj jazbati taur par mushkil ho sakta hai; mareez pareshani, udasi ya bojh mehsoos kar sakte hain.

blocks.title: Ulti simtein kyun?
blocks.text: Dialyzer mein khoon aur dialysate ulti simton mein behte hain. Membrane ke poore raaste khoon se milne wala dialysate khoon se zyada taaza hota hai, to fuzlaat poori lambai mein bahar diffuse hote rehte hain, bajaye is ke ke dono mayaat aadhe raaste barabar ho jayen.

blocks.prompt: Haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis ka muqabla kijiye: har aik mein filter kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Haemodialysis mein filter jism ke bahar dialyzer ki cellulose semipermeable membrane hai; peritoneal dialysis mein mareez ka apna peritoneum, pait ki andaruni teh.

items: Chronic failure: aahista, la-ilaj (ziabetes, high blood pressure); acute: achanak, aksar qabil-e-ilaj (infection, rukawat, NSAIDs, lothre).
Haemodialysis: cellulose membrane wala dialyzer, ulta behta dialysate. Peritoneal: 1.5 se 2 L pait mein 4 se 6 ghante. Khatre: infection, kam blood pressure, cramps, anaemia.
